stories.title: A platter of storms being served up from Thanksgiving Day into early next week

stories.title: 'So cruel': Husband of woman detained by ICE at SEA Airport says ICE operations must change
stories.summary: José Castillo said federal officers "stalked" his family through SEA Airport, rushed them without identification and traumatized the family and other passengers.

stories.title: How to watch Ultimate Boise Sports Show streaming on KTVB
stories.summary: KTVB launches The Ultimate Boise Sports Show to capture the Treasure Valley's unique passion, featuring local teams, guests and deep dives Idaho into sports stories.

stories.title: Brabeion Academy founder Branden Durst separates from school. State also investigating alleged financial questions
stories.summary: The Idaho Public Charter School Commission is investigating financial irregularities at Brabeion Academy. The academy's founder has confirmed he's stepping away.

stories.title: Cool it, can it, trash it: Meridian urges residents to keep Thanksgiving grease out of your drain
stories.summary: Before you clean up Thanksgiving dinner, Meridian wants you to know that grease down the drain can mean a costly sewage backup. Here's what to do with it instead.

stories.title: Washington-based Wizards of the Coast sues Utah family for $26.5 million over alleged counterfeit Magic cards
stories.summary: Shopify shut down a store selling fake Magic cards in 2020. Wizards of the Coast says the seller moved offshore and kept growing.

stories.title: St. Vincent de Paul Thanksgiving food drive helps feed more than 17,000 people
stories.summary: “It's just amazing to see our community come together." The drive will give away over 3,500 boxes of Thanksgiving food to people from around the Treasure Valley.

stories.title: Man charged in reckless crash on Boise Bench arraigned, granted pretrial release
stories.summary: Gavin Schmid, charged with two felony counts of aggravated reckless driving in a crash that killed a 15-year-old, appeared in Ada County court Tuesday.

stories.title: Cassia County Sheriff's Office warns residents of scam by fake probation officers
stories.summary: Cassia County Sheriff's Office warns of a scam where callers pose as probation officers, demanding gift card or cryptocurrency payments for "releasing" inmates.

stories.title: Three Idaho big game guides sentenced for illegal mountain lion hunts
stories.summary: According to court records, at least 11 mountain lions were killed in the District of Idaho during illegal hunts conducted by the group over a three-month period.
